name: Reflect
doc: Reflect (spell; Carbuncle's Ruby Light's "ruby" part in its own copy): one barrier per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks, not while one of 35 ticks or less runs on that target): a frame on the target turned with it and scaled by its size, a wall model growing up through it with a scrolling texture then fading out, eight hexagons orbiting a point that climbs the wall, three rings growing above the target; the result at 35, the end at 40. Its beams are vanilla dead code: allocated, never drawn, they still draw shared random numbers.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory (no magic buffer: its pools and packet arenas are module memory).

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

wall.doc: the reflect wall (+4 vertex count, +8 vertices of 8 bytes, then its primitive lists)

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The director starts one barrier per action, in turn (not while a young one runs on that target), with its hexagons; each barrier's clock: its frame on the target, its sound, its result, its end; the dead beams (draws nothing)

parts.title: Wall
parts.doc: The wall model growing up through the barrier's frame, its texture scrolling, then fading out

parts.title: Hexagons
parts.doc: Hexagon models orbiting a point that climbs the wall, tilting, then squashed and faded

parts.title: Rings
parts.doc: Ring models growing above the target, one every few wall steps

groups.label: Tilt speed
groups.doc: Their tilt a tick: Base - (rand & Mask)

params.label: Every
params.doc: The director starts the next action's barrier every this many ticks

params.label: Busy tick
params.doc: Not while a barrier on that target is at this tick or before (the cycle restarts; -1: never)

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the barrier tick == this

params.label: Sound volume
params.doc: BdPlaySE3D's volume argument

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the barrier tick == this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The barrier ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Size shift
params.doc: Its frame scaled by min(the target's size << this, 4096)

params.label: From tick
params.doc: The wall is drawn from this barrier tick...

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: ...for this many ticks

params.label: Grow steps
params.doc: It grows up over its first steps (this many + 1)...

params.label: Fade steps
params.doc: ...then fades out over this many

params.label: Count
params.doc: Hexagons spawned with each barrier

params.label: Climb ticks
params.doc: Their centre climbs the wall's vertices over the barrier's first ticks...

params.label: Climb steps
params.doc: ...this many vertices

params.label: Tilt
params.doc: Their first X rotation (4096 = a turn)

params.label: Angle step
params.doc: Their first angles apart around the centre

params.label: Turn
params.doc: Their turn a tick (its side random)

params.label: End tick
params.doc: A hexagon ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Fade from
params.doc: Squashed and faded after this tick...

params.label: Fade ticks
params.doc: ...over this many

params.label: Every
params.doc: A ring every this many wall steps from the wall's first tick...

params.label: Last tick
params.doc: ...to this barrier tick

params.label: Size
params.doc: Its first size (4096 = its own)

params.label: Growth
params.doc: Its first growth a tick

params.label: Brake
params.doc: Added to its growth a tick...

params.label: Least growth
params.doc: ...down to this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: A ring ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Fade ticks
params.doc: Faded in and out (a half sine) over this many

params.label: Dead beams
params.doc: Vanilla dead code: beams allocated a tick while the centre climbs, each drawing a shared random number while their pool has room (never drawn)

tasks.doc: One per action: its frame on the target (turned with it, scaled by its size, at the middle of its effect points 0xF0 / 0xF1) and the hexagons' centre climbing the wall's vertices; the hexagons at its first tick; the dead beams; the wall growing, scrolling, fading; a ring every few wall steps; its sound, the result, its end.
A hexagon model orbiting the barrier's climbing centre, Z-rotated against its angle, tilting, squashed and faded at the end.
A ring model above the barrier at the wall's top when it spawned, growing (braking), faded in and out.
